caption: The drawing depicts several objects related to candle holders and stands, illustrated in shades of gold, brass, black, and gray. The primary object in the center is a tall, ornate, tripod floor-standing candlestick with a decorative twisted central stem, topped by a horizontal bar that holds two small candle holders, each supporting a white candle. To the left, there is a detailed view of a single candlestick with a broad, shallow dish base and a central holder for a candle, mostly colored in gold and brass tones. Below this is a close-up of one of the tripod stand’s legs, showcasing engraved decorations and the rounded golden attachment at the point where the leg joins the vertical stem. On the right side of the drawing, there is a close-up of an openwork cylindrical section of the stand, displaying spiral designs within a cage-like structure, drawn in gray and black. At the bottom right, there is a detailed view of a segment of the stand's pole, illustrating twisting and spiral patterns and a series of golden ring-like shapes along the shaft. The artist's name, J. Staloff, is written within a rectangle near the bottom center of the illustration. The background is a neutral off-white with a subtle border framing the drawing.
title: Candlestand
cluster: #16 — Lighting Devices: Lamps, Lanterns, and Candleholders
